_doc: FMS P-51D Mustang 1450, docs/P51-STAGE1.md. Every band is the derived figure's (scripts/p51-derive.js) in the Kadet's and the Timber's proportions, never widened to pass.

p1_level_75.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 15.06 on the straight line, which under-read the thrust at speed; the band the same 0.880 to 1.120 of the derived (was 13.25 to 16.87)

p2_stall.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.665 (scripts/p51-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 4.96: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.21169. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.050 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.064, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.050 / 1.114) = 0.9708.

p2_stall_flaps.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.665 (scripts/p51-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 4.96: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.18528. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.502 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.057, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.502 / 1.558) = 0.9817.

p4_top.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 20.64; the band the same 0.910 to 1.120 of the derived (was 18.78 to 23.12)

p4_gear_delta.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the gear's drag costs more speed where the curve holds the thrust up, was 0.452; the band the same 0.44 to 1.77 of the derived (was 0.2 to 0.8)

p5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 11.33 at 14.8 m/s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 6.57 at 12.0 m/s; the band the same 0.750 to 1.250 of the derived (was 4.93 to 8.21), the sweep moved with the best climb speed, from 1 m/s under it (was 11 to 16)

p7_coast.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): from the higher top speed, was 17.10; the band the same 5.3 percent either way (was 16.2 to 18.0)

p9_phugoid.source: the phugoid root trimmed at the 75 percent speed. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the trim speed rose from 15.06 to 19.72 m/s, was 11.44; the band the same 0.822 to 1.163 of the derived (was 9.40 to 13.30). The derivation trims at cm_0 0.0111 there; the plant's table still carries 0.0183, the old trim, until the lead lane writes it

p14_takeoff.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 14 x 8 four blade curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/p51-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the roll is shorter with the thrust held up to lift off, was 8.80 m; the distance band the same 0.75 to 1.5 of the derived (was 6.6 to 13.2), the speed unchanged
